build_google_benchmark: build the Google Benchmark microbenchmark library using Conan and CMake with configurable options
configure_cmake_definitions: configure CMake definitions for LTO, exceptions, and 32-bit builds in the Google Benchmark Conan recipe
package_benchmark_lib: package the built Google Benchmark library and copy the LICENSE file into the Conan package
config_options_windows: configure build options to disable fPIC on Windows and validate Visual Studio version compatibility
collect_libs_platform: collect platform-specific libraries like pthread, rt, shlwapi, or kstat for the benchmark package info
